status: EXPERIMENTAL Gate X build recipe. Not a release recipe and not an approval of these inputs.

toolchain.libc: the toolchain's self-contained musl crt objects and libc.a (link-self-contained=yes), not the image's musl-dev
toolchain.compressor: BusyBox v1.37.0 gzip applet of the same image, not GNU gzip

build.network: none (docker run --network none); the crate has no dependencies, so nothing is fetched
build.environment: env -i, then only PATH, RUSTC, HOME, CARGO_HOME, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, TZ=UTC, LC_ALL=C, LANG=C, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, RUSTFLAGS
build.profile: release: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic unwind, strip symbols, no debug info
build.source_date_epoch_meaning: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, a fixed constant. It is not derived from any commit, so adding the assets cannot change it; rustc embeds no timestamp either way.
build.no_build_stamp: No git SHA, date, host name or path is embedded; the work directory name differs on every build.

compression.envelope: one member; header 1f8b 08 00 00000000 02 03 (deflate, no flags, mtime 0, xfl 2, os 3); deflate data; CRC32 and ISIZE of the ELF; nothing after the trailer
compression.equality: the committed .gz must equal a fresh compression of a fresh build byte for byte, and must decompress to that build byte for byte
